title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to disable/hide OneDrive action group for all users
summary: The post explains how to disable or hide OneDrive action groups in Dynamics 365 Business Central for all users. It covers three methods: using personalization on individual pages, using page customization and extensions, and using the OneDrive Setup guide or Privacy Notices Status page to manage OneDrive features globally.
key_points: OneDrive actions (Open in OneDrive, Share, Edit in OneDrive) are available on pages with files like Report Inbox and document attachments
Page-level customization hides OneDrive actions only on specific pages, requiring modifications to multiple pages to hide them everywhere
Administrators can disable OneDrive features for all users through the OneDrive Setup assisted setup guide or by marking Disagree for Everyone on the Privacy Notices Status page
OneDrive integration is automatically configured and enabled in Business Central online, with two option categories: Use for app features and Use for system features

quotes.text: Unlike Power Automate action groups, we can move or hide OneDrive actions using personalization.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary UI-based method available for managing OneDrive actions without code changes

quotes.text: In the Microsoft OneDrive row, select the Disagree for Everyone check box.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the exact step to globally disable OneDrive for all users through privacy settings
